question: Who is the governor of Reserve Bank of India as of 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaktikanta Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The current Governor is Shaktikanta Das
 
• Raghuram Rajan was the 23rd Governor of the Reserve Bank of India
 
• The organizational structure of RBI is via the Central Board of Directors (CBD). The Transfer of Public Ownership Act provides for the constitution of CBD and Local Board by the Central Government. The CBD can have a maximum of 20 members. Besides these members, RBI has one Governor, and four Deputy Governors appointed by the Central Government. Their tenure in office is 5 years for Governor and 4 years for Deputy governor. Also in the organizational structure are Executive Directors.
 
• Presently Shri Shaktikanta Das is the 25th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India since December 2018, who took over the charge from Dr. Urjit Patel. To start with the first person appointed as the Governor of RBI was Sir Osborne Smith.
 
• The RBI Act provides that CBD conducts one meeting every quarter and at least 6 meetings in a year.
 
• Important details about the Governors of RBI:
 
 
• Shaktikanta Das: He is the current Governor of RBI. He took office on 12th December 2018. He is the 25th governor of RBI.
 
• Raghuram Rajan: He was the former governor of RBI from 4 September 2013 to 4 September 2016.
 
• Y.V Reddy: He was the former governor of RBI from 6 September 2003 to 5 September 2008.
 
• Urjit Patel: He was the former governor of RBI from 4 September 2016 to 11 December 2018.
